# linear_custom_view (Resource)

Manages a Linear custom view — a saved, filtered list of issues, projects, initiatives or feed items.

The filter goes through as a JSON object rather than typed HCL. Linear's `IssueFilter` alone has 122 top-level fields and nests arbitrarily, and the server normalises what it stores, so a typed schema would freeze against a moving API and a plain string would report drift on every plan. The `*_json` attributes are compared semantically instead.

Set exactly one of `filter_json`, `project_filter_json`, `initiative_filter_json` or `feed_item_filter_json` — which one decides what the view lists.

```terraform
resource "linear_custom_view" "in_review" {
  name    = "In Review"
  team_id = linear_team.eng.id
  shared  = true

  filter_json = jsonencode({
    state  = { type = { eq = "started" } }
    labels = { some = { name = { eq = "ai" } } }
  })
}
```

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The reason this provider exists. The filter goes through as JSON and is
# compared semantically, so Linear's server-side normalisation is not drift.
resource "linear_custom_view" "in_review" {
  name        = "In Review"
  description = "Everything waiting on a reviewer"
  team_id     = linear_team.engineering.id
  shared      = true
  color       = "#0f7488"

  filter_json = jsonencode({
    state  = { type = { eq = "started" } }
    labels = { some = { name = { eq = "ai" } } }
  })
}

# Set a different filter to make it a project, initiative or feed view — exactly
# one of the four may be set.
resource "linear_custom_view" "active_projects" {
  name   = "Active projects"
  shared = true

  project_filter_json = jsonencode({
    status = { type = { eq = "started" } }
  })
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the view.

### Optional

- `color` (String) Colour of the view icon as a hex string.
- `description` (String) Description of the view.
- `feed_item_filter_json` (String) Feed item filter as a JSON object. Makes this a feed view.
- `filter_json` (String) Issue filter as a JSON object, e.g. `jsonencode({ state = { type = { eq = "started" } } })`. Compared semantically, so Linear's server-side normalisation is not reported as drift.
- `icon` (String) Icon of the view.
- `initiative_filter_json` (String) Initiative filter as a JSON object. Makes this an initiative view.
- `initiative_id` (String) UUID of the initiative the view is scoped to. **Write-only**, for the same reason as `project_id`.
- `owner_id` (String) UUID of the user who owns the view. Defaults to whoever the API key belongs to.
- `project_filter_json` (String) Project filter as a JSON object. Makes this a project view.
- `project_id` (String) UUID of the project the view is scoped to. **Write-only**: Linear exposes a view's projects as a connection rather than as this id, so drift in this attribute cannot be detected.
- `shared` (Boolean) Whether the view is visible to the whole workspace rather than only its owner.
- `team_id` (String) UUID of the team the view is scoped to. Leave unset for a workspace-wide view.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) UUID of the view.
- `model_name` (String) What the view lists, derived by Linear from whichever filter is set — `Issue`, `Project`, `Initiative` or `FeedItem`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by UUID.
terraform import linear_custom_view.example a1b2c3d4-0000-0000-0000-000000000000
```
